title: Stays asleep
line: Stops the touch panel from waking the Win Max 2 right after it goes to sleep.
symptom: The Win Max 2 (2025 especially) wakes again at once: its I2C touch device (PNP0C50:00) is a wakeup source.
why: The WIN Max 2 body's I2C touch device (PNP0C50:00).
risk_note: One udev rule. Its source calls it not yet widely tested, so it isn't preselected.

changes.detail: Switches off wake-up for the I2C touch device PNP0C50:00.
Set to disabled at once; the old value is saved.

undo: Deletes the rule and writes the saved value back.

probe.what: Looks for the same rule from the system itself (any udev rule that isn't GameCove's and does the same), or the value already being right without GameCove.

watch.note: The workaround's source: a change or removal there is the first sign it's no longer needed.
Where a kernel quirk for the touch device's wake-up would land.
